 Kayak Through Door County’s Stunning Autumn Colors
Experience Wisconsin’s stunning autumn colors as we paddle into caves, near bluffs, and through some beautiful estuaries. We do our best to kayak the safest and most scenic location based upon weather conditions. Based on wind/wave direction and strength on the day of your tour, we decide where we can kayak.

We typically visit:

Cave Point

Bluff Shipwreck

Eco-Estuary Tour

Clients often request to kayak Cave Point or the Bluff Shipwreck in the fall, but we need to make sure conditions are safe and enjoyable. If we are not able to go to either of those locations, we take you on our eco-estuary tour instead. We want to make sure you understand we won’t be cancelling the tour, only changing locations. If there is bad weather (rain/storms), we do our best to reschedule everyone. If you are not able to reschedule, we issue you a gift certificate.

 Cancellation Policy

You have 48 hours before the tour to cancel and still receive a refund.

If there are strong winds and waves, we try to reschedule your tour to another time. If you do not have other availability, we kayak in a more protected location. This happens on about 10-15% of our tours. We are not able to control the weather… yet. We are happy to issue you a return discount to come back if we are not able to safely see your requested tour location.

If there is lightning/thunder, we do our best to reschedule the tour to a later time or day. If you are not able to make a later time, we refund your deposit.
